notes.title: Global Update 2018!
Blockade Update "Christmas Adventure" - 30.12.17
notes.notes:
Good day to the fighters of the Blockade. We are glad to welcome you on this wonderful day!

On behalf of the Administration and developers of the game we hasten to congratulate you on the upcoming New Year 2018! We also want to express our gratitude to all those who, during this difficult year for the project, stayed with us and supported us. We are sincerely grateful to you for being with us! Without you, the game has not achieved, such a success! In the new year we want to wish you success in life and fulfillment of desires, and the game has fewer bugs and as many interesting updates and gifts. Do not forget to obey the Admins and do not violate the rules of the game. Respect yourself and others!

Many of you are waiting for the biggest update, which we announced a long time ago. We have good news for you. At the moment, we are in the final stages of preparing to launch an open beta of the global update. It will be available in the social network VK in January for players who have reached the 10th level. To the news are attached screenshots that will shed light on some changes from the global update.

In the meantime, we have released for you a small New Year's update, which is already installed on the server.

List of changes and innovations:
- The holiday mode "Snowballs" is added to the game. Entry to the mode is possible only in a New Year's suit!
- The list of "Snowballs" mode maps was supplemented by 5 new maps: WINTER ARENA, SNOW WAR, LAPLAND, MINE, ZONE. Authors of maps received an award (does not apply to winners of competitions). All the maps have been redesigned taking into account the game mechanics mode.
- The design of the game is changed to a festive one.
- Added New Year skins from past updates (11 skins).
- Added New Year's masks, hats and horns from past updates.
- Changed the rate of fire SR25.
- On Dec. 31, Easter eggs will appear in the game. Details on Easter eggs will appear closer to December 31! Follow the news.
- Skin SILENT ASSASSIN appears on sale after January 5.
- All the players were given gifts (consumables). Do not rush to spend consumables. You will need them when doing missions!
- Launched the "New Year Adventure 2018". Light all the lights on the tree, including the star, alternately performing missions! After completing all the missions, you will receive a set of weapons from the "Winter Camouflage" series, a special award to the Hall of Fame, as well as a bunch of consumables and coins. The series "Winter camouflage" includes weapons: AK47, SR25, P90, SAIGA, USP.

General rules for missions:
1. It is not possible to perform missions on private servers;
2. Missions are possible only on servers with a minimum of 16 players (except survival mode);
3. Players attempting to perform missions unfairly will be punished;
4. All missions are carried out in strict sequence. The tasks within the mission are performed simultaneously;
5. To complete the current mission, you need to open the New Year's adventure window. In it, you will see the terms of the next mission.

Awards for the task: A set of weapons from the "Winter camouflage" series, a reward to the hall of fame, consumables, experience.

All actions, regime and skins until January 21 at 11:59:59 PM.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7404960/acbaa3bbd8a088576b604c8cbbbb2ae626b69d72.png[/img]

More screenshots here: https://vk.com/wall-51949926_34222

Have a good game!
